scope: Read-only source audit of committed Windows candidate; no deployment or runtime consumer verification.

findings.finding: publicClient uses BASE_RPCS fallback including five public defaults, without selecting ENCLAVE_CHAIN_AUTHORITY. Same client handles ordinary contract reads, paged deployment enumeration, pending nonce, simulation, receipt polling, gas estimates, event logs, tx input and historic blocks. Wallet transport separately uses same public list. A pinned read snapshot cannot substitute for this full interface.
findings.next: Separate verified state reads and coherent multi-read snapshots from explicitly configured transaction/receipt/history capabilities. No fallback to public endpoints when verifier mode explicitly selected. Keep compatibility and truthful unavailable states; do not mark replacement complete until needed methods work.

findings.finding: Windows has a separate quorumReader implementation and CLI check-endpoint builds rpcClients from public defaults; source comments cite missing shared bundle export.
findings.next: Use shared validated authority selection via shipped Windows-compatible bundle, preserve default-quorum behavior while explicit verifier selection has no raw fallback. Test shipped import/deploy-files closure and actual endpoint ownership checks.

findings.finding: Session API uses chain publicClient at construction; bootstrap/checkpoint callers also receive it. Chain RPC URLs are passed into identity metadata.
findings.next: Actual caller closure must cover session revocation, delegated access and authority/admin changes coherently, without weakening local auth or misreporting RPC URLs as independent availability.

findings.finding: Operator CLI constructs independent public/wallet clients and another quorumReader. Changing agent config alone does not replace these calls.
findings.next: Wire explicit read authority and independently configured transaction transport; preserve admin and owner rights and all app-paid lease semantics. Do not send transactions in tests.

findings.finding: Current shared pinned client supports getChainId/getBlockNumber/getBlock/readContract/getCode/getBytecode/getStorageAt/getBalance only; transactions, receipt/log/inclusion and pending nonce are separate unresolved capabilities.
findings.next: Reuse existing proof-backed primitives; do not turn unsupported calls into silently trusted fallback. P/E transaction-inclusion/L1 and fresh holder work remain prerequisites for full independence.

acceptance: Actual caller/constructed-client tests with public RPC sockets denied, not source-string assertions only.
Keep admin moderation, owner permissions, live book migration, session revocation and existing features.
Multi-read authorization and paginated enumeration must remain tied to an authenticated coherent head.
Test stale/missing verifier and shutdown, no fallback; preserve explicit default legacy mode.
Read-only path closure is not proof of independent transaction inclusion or fresh witness availability.
